source: on the control plane RegexStringMatcher runs each filter regex in MatchingTimeoutExecutor too, both directions (filter -> recorded value, and recorded value -> filter); a catastrophic retrieve, verify, verifySequence or clear filter (path `/(.*a){25}` against a recorded 40-character path) passes regexMatchingTimeoutMillis (here 300), logs the WARN `regex evaluation timed out after {}ms for pattern:{}— treating as non-match`, and the recorded request is not selected.

steps.note: a second recorded request: each evaluation times out and logs its own WARN
the filter times out against the recorded path: nothing is selected
the order of the retrieve and verify WARNs
